dateline: BTS closed three sold-out La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) of the ARIRANG World Tour; São Paulo shows are scheduled for Oct 28, 30 and 31 at Estádio MorumBIS.
heroHeadline: Day 4,885: BTS Open São Paulo Leg of ARIRANG World Tour
heroSubtitle: October 28, 2026 is Day 4,885 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three La Plata nights, the ARIRANG World Tour reaches São Paulo, with dates listed for October 28, 30 and 31; the October 30 show is slated for cinema live viewing.
